summary: Auth compatibility with installs of the earlier library entry, read-only (Greptile PR #2450 round 2 P1; orchestrator decision after Codex novel1219-r7: no migration, no file writes). Env: CONDUYT_CRM_BEARER_AUTH, then CONDUYT_BEARER_AUTH, then CONDUYT_API_KEY, a legacy name with one deprecation line on stderr. Saved keys: bearer_auth / api_key are extra field names of the same documents the CLI already loads: cliutil.Credentials carries them (LegacyBearerAuth / LegacyAPIKey), the existing checked-descriptor loader parses them from the same bytes, HasValues counts them (so an unsafe or aliased file is a present refusal that suppresses the global fallback exactly as for crm_bearer_auth), ApplyLegacyKeys fills the bearer only when the document has no crm_bearer_auth (bearer_auth before api_key), and credentialsFileFrom never writes them; the config file's are read inside parseConfigData over cliutil.ReadOpenedConfig's bytes. Nothing is rewritten; one notice names the file and 'conduyt-crm-pp-cli auth set-token'. No secret value is printed. cliutil/credentials.go is generator-owned: this patch must be re-applied on a reprint. Round 9 (Codex novel1219-r8): a document that has crm_bearer_auth at all, even empty (an explicitly cleared token), ignores bearer_auth / api_key (decodeCredentialsDocument; applyLegacyConfigKey checks key presence); a set-but-blank env name decides and never falls through to a later name (unresolved MCP placeholders do not decide); the existing writers clean up after themselves: SaveTokens (auth set-token) drops a bearer that came from an earlier key before saving and, after a successful save, removes bearer_auth / api_key from the explicit profile's and the global credentials file (cliutil.ScrubLegacyCredentialKeys: checked-descriptor read, the SaveCredentials private writer, verified); ClearTokens (auth logout) also removes the explicit profile's credentials file (cliutil.RemoveProfileCredentials), as it removes the global one; logout names a legacy env var that still supplies the token, like CONDUYT_CRM_BEARER_AUTH (config.LegacyAuthEnvInEffect).
reason: The 4.34.2 reprint reads only CONDUYT_CRM_BEARER_AUTH and crm_bearer_auth; existing installs that use the earlier env names or saved keys would lose authentication on upgrade.
validated_outcome: TestLegacyAuthEnvPrecedence, TestLegacyAuthConfigKeysReadInPlace, TestLegacyAuthCredentialsFilesReadInPlace (profile first; global with matching / other origin), TestLegacyAuthUnsafeProfileFileSuppressesGlobalFallback, TestLegacyAuthMixedDocumentKeepsFieldPrecedence, TestLegacyAuthTrustOutcomesMatchTheCurrentKey (loose mode, symlinked profile data directory, owner-only: legacy keys get the current key's outcome; legacy_auth.go has no file I/O), TestLegacyAuthUntrustedConfigFileIsRefused and TestLegacyAuthSavesNeverWriteLegacyKeys pass, every file unchanged and no secret in any output; the FULL live gate passes with CONDUYT_CRM_BEARER_AUTH and with only CONDUYT_BEARER_AUTH. Round 9: TestLegacyAuthEmptyCurrentKeyNeverResurrectsALegacyKey (config, profile and global documents), TestLegacyAuthReSaveReplacesTheEarlierKey, TestLegacyAuthLogoutClearsTheProfileAndGlobalFiles, TestAuthLogoutReportsLegacyEnvNames (JSON and prose, both legacy names) and the blank-env rows of TestLegacyAuthEnvPrecedence.
